**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve replay compatibility for existing interest inbox rows**

For interest payouts received before this deployment, the inbox already stores `eventData.destination_wallet` as `wallet_id`, including payouts left failed by `INTEREST_LEDGER_UNMAPPED`. Replaying the identical signed event now supplies `pvb_wallet`, but `recordPiggyvestEvent` in `webhook-inbox.ts` requires the stored and incoming wallet IDs to match. Consequently, `process-delivery.ts` quarantines and acknowledges those retries before reaching the corrected interest ledger, leaving the previously missed payouts uncredited. Migrate the existing inbox attribution from verified evidence or add a narrowly validated compatibility path so those failed deliveries can actually recover.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
